notes.title: Delve into the Unknown: Other Side of Mist and Mountain is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Other Side of Mist and Mountain, a Japanese-styled mystery-solving AVG developed by Universe Studio and published by 2P Games, has been released on Steam NOW！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672060/_/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/50fe8a23d30235ed758866076dab7f7ddd9c943a.png[/img]
This game is based on a true urban tale, which makes this game become a suspenseful and sinister detective story with Japanese background. 

[h3]Find your beloved missing girl [/h3]
In 2005, a sophomore student named Maha Igarashi boarded a private train to Soukyo City. However, she vanished upon alighting at the "Kisaragi" station. Five years later, her lover Shizuno Yokoyama investigated her disappearance, unraveling a series of mysteries along the way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/98958100bd168311743df79441168bdc7b2f8fa1.png[/img]

[h3]Delve into the unknown [/h3]
You will play the role of Shizuno Yokoyama and open a detective agency specialized on unnatural cases, investigating the occurrence of weird events. You need to go to where strange events happened to investigate every detail of the place. Talk to everyone you meet, find out the clues and information from the smallest details and eventually dig out the truth behind the events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/cc6ec6bee2cf6e8bfd4ff847283b37c0120ec57a.png[/img]

[h3]Collect clues and solve mechanism puzzles [/h3]
There are a variety of different mechanism puzzles waiting for the player to solve.  Every detail in the scene may be a hint to useful information such as the date on the notebook or the unusual color arrangement of a planet and so on. The game challenges the player's insight and logical reasoning ability through the interlocking puzzle design. In the process of solving the puzzles, you may also fight with something that shouldn’t have existed. Only the sharpest reaction will bring you back alive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/ef9697b0b6f25accc73992c7bbb05f1925669c82.png[/img]

[h3]Make choices, change the destiny of everyone [/h3]
The game has multiple endings. Every choice will affect Shizuno’s fate and only the correct choice can guide you step by step close to the truth of the incident, while the wrong choice will completely rewrite the fate of everyone. After solving unnatural incidents one after another, you will gradually uncover the truth of the disappearance of Maha Igarashi, and eventually bring the story to its climax. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/80defba63f917968f232248952c22df20b382097.png[/img]

notes.title: Delay release announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Detectives:

To ensure that players can have a more complete and immersive game experience, we decided to change the way of selling. We will add the DLC to the official version of the game's body. Thus, the official release of The Other Side of Mist and Mountain will be adjusted to the relade date which was originally scheduled on December 24th.
 
At the same time, our team is also improving the product. We are enriching the content and optimizing the design of the subsequent chapters.
 
In subsequent chapters, Arashiya's Detective Agency will have more and more bizarre commissions. The sweet couple seem harmonious but actually have their own axe to grind. Yokoyama will also unlock the Coral Apartment, the cemetery in the building, and other mysterious locations. Another main character—Igarashi Mahane's body, the strange house lord, weird cat, rapidly growing bodies, and a damsel with amnesia. What relations are among all of these? Every detective needs to make a careful decision and uncover the fog to find the truth of everything.
 
Finally, we appreciate all the players for their continuous support and love of The Other Side of Mist and Mountain. Please trust us, temporary waiting is for a better meet, the official version will not let you wait too long. Let's look forward to it!

notes.title: A letter of invitation letter from the “Arashiya”detective agency
notes.notes:
Dear Detectives:
Five years ago, my future wife, a fair-skinned and beautiful sophomore college student Igarashi Mahane, took a private train to Soukyo City to attend a social pop-up event organized by a supernatural niche forum. On the way, she stopped at a place called He disappeared after getting off the train at “Kisaragi"; the platform has also disappeared since then.
To find her, I quit my job in the city and opened a detective agency in my hometown to take on "weird tasks" just to search for clues about Igarashi Mahane. As the investigation deepened, I discovered that something was getting more confusing, and it was hard to get out...

Now, I officially appeal to all detectives for help, hoping they can help me find the truth behind Igarashi Mahane’s disappearance and help me find my girlfriend!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/9cac871d98a0a8a64c901d296461035d593c72b1.png[/img]
